title: Bruce Anthony Charles arrested on terrorizing and cyberstalking charges in Assumption Parish
text:
Bruce Anthony Charles arrested on terrorizing and cyberstalking charges in Assumption Parish
Bruce Anthony Charles, 34, of New Orleans, was arrested on multiple felony charges related to threats and harassment following an investigation by the Assumption Parish Sheriff’s Office that began June 16. The sheriff’s office received a complaint from a woman who said she was being threatened by her former domestic partner.
Detectives interviewed the victim, who stated that she and Charles have a child together but are now estranged. As part of their investigation, detectives reviewed electronic messages sent by Charles, which included threats of violence directed at the complainant, her child, and her fiancé. Detectives also identified a prior history of violence involving Charles.
Following their findings, detectives secured arrest warrants for Bruce Anthony Charles. The New Orleans Police Department arrested him on June 17. He was then released to the custody of the Assumption Parish Sheriff’s Office on June 23.
Charles was booked into the Assumption Parish Detention Center on two counts of terrorizing, cyberstalking, and telephone communications involving improper language and harassment. He remains incarcerated pending a bond hearing.
For additional information regarding this case or news release, contact Sheriff Leland Falcon or Public Information Officer Lonny Cavalier at (985) 498-9353 or (985) 369-2912.
